targets.rawSql:
SELECT 'Total Proxies' as metric, COUNT(*) as value FROM proxies WHERE  state = 'Quebec'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Active Proxies' as metric, COUNT(*) as value FROM proxies WHERE active = true and  state = 'Quebec'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Inactive Proxies' as metric, COUNT(*) as value FROM proxies WHERE active = false and  state = 'Quebec'

panels.title: Proxies In Montreal
panels.description: This metric shows the current value of proxies in montreal for the selected period. It should be used as a quick health checkpoint before deeper drill-down.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ProxyStats AS (
    SELECT
      proxy_id,
      AVG(download_speed_mbps) AS avg_download,
      MIN(download_speed_mbps) AS min_download,
      MAX(download_speed_mbps) AS max_download,
      AVG(upload_speed_mbps) AS avg_upload,
      MIN(upload_speed_mbps) AS min_upload,
      MAX(upload_speed_mbps) AS max_upload,
      MAX(timestamp) AS last_test,
      COUNT(*) AS test_count
    FROM speed_tests
    WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    GROUP BY proxy_id
),
MedianDL AS (
    SELECT
      proxy_id,
      AVG(download_speed_mbps) AS median_download
    FROM (
      SELECT
        proxy_id,
        download_speed_mbps,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY proxy_id
          ORDER BY download_speed_mbps
        ) AS row_num,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY proxy_id) AS total_count
      FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
          proxy_id,
          download_speed_mbps
        FROM speed_tests
        WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
          AND download_speed_mbps IS NOT NULL
      ) d
    ) t
    WHERE row_num IN (
      (total_count + 1) / 2,
      (total_count + 2) / 2
    )
    GROUP BY proxy_id
),
MedianUL AS (
    SELECT
      proxy_id,
      AVG(upload_speed_mbps) AS median_upload
    FROM (
      SELECT
        proxy_id,
        upload_speed_mbps,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY proxy_id
          ORDER BY upload_speed_mbps
        ) AS row_num,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY proxy_id) AS total_count
      FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
          proxy_id,
          upload_speed_mbps
        FROM speed_tests
        WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
          AND upload_speed_mbps IS NOT NULL
      ) d
    ) t
    WHERE row_num IN (
      (total_count + 1) / 2,
      (total_count + 2) / 2
    )
    GROUP BY proxy_id
),
RequestStats AS (
    SELECT
      proxy_id,
      COUNT(*) AS total_requests,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) AS success_count,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN status != 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) AS error_count,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS request_success_rate
    FROM proxy_requests
    WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    GROUP BY proxy_id
),
RotationStats AS (
    SELECT
      proxy_id,
      COUNT(DISTINCT cycle_id) AS rotation_cycles_count,
      COUNT(*) AS total_rotation_attempts,
      SUM(CASE WHEN success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_rotations,
      SUM(CASE WHEN success = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_rotations,
      SUM(CASE WHEN success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS rotation_success_percentage,
      MAX(rotation_timestamp) AS last_rotation_attempt
    FROM ip_rotations
    WHERE $__timeFilter(rotation_timestamp)
    GROUP BY proxy_id
)
SELECT
  p.name,
  p.device_id,
  p.city,
  p.ws_status,
  p.proxy_status,
  p.version,
  ps.last_test,
  ps.avg_download,
  md.median_download,
  ps.min_download,
  ps.max_download,
  ps.avg_upload,
  mu.median_upload,
  ps.min_upload,
  ps.max_upload,
  COALESCE(rs.total_requests, 0) AS total_requests,
  -- COALESCE(rs.success_count, 0) AS success_count,
  -- COALESCE(rs.error_count, 0) AS error_count,
  COALESCE(rs.request_success_rate, 0) AS request_success_rate,
  -- COALESCE(rot.rotation_cycles_count, 0) AS rotation_cycles_count,
  COALESCE(rot.total_rotation_attempts, 0) AS total_rotation_attempts,
  -- COALESCE(rot.successful_rotations, 0) AS successful_rotations,
  -- COALESCE(rot.failed_rotations, 0) AS failed_rotations,
  COALESCE(rot.rotation_success_percentage, 0) AS rotation_success_percentage,
  rot.last_rotation_attempt
FROM proxies p
LEFT JOIN ProxyStats ps ON p.device_id = ps.proxy_id
LEFT JOIN MedianDL md ON p.device_id = md.proxy_id
LEFT JOIN MedianUL mu ON p.device_id = mu.proxy_id
LEFT JOIN RequestStats rs ON p.device_id = rs.proxy_id
LEFT JOIN RotationStats rot ON p.device_id = rot.proxy_id
WHERE LOWER(p.city) = 'montreal'
  AND p.active = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.avg_download DESC;

panels.title: Active Montreal Proxies
panels.description: This metric shows the percentage of requests that completed successfully in the selected period. It is the primary reliability indicator and should be read alongside request volume for context.
